games.name: FREEZE
games.character_role: Absent from the game world. The only character art is a faint ambient decal that sits on the top-right corner of the 'me and' card and is half cut off at the left stage edge (phone start tile). No character reacts to taps, freezes or thaws.
games.finale: Finish (phone and desktop finish tiles): six identical cards each with the same white starburst and ice wave, plus a tilted dark toast with unreadable text. Reveal: the shared text card ('CALMER ✓ THE LOOP GOT INTERRUPTED' on phone, 'PANIC ↓ YOU BROKE THE PATTERN' on desktop) with no character and no game-specific moment. The promised SHATTER never happens. Not unique.
games.score_rationale: A4: flat neon gradient cards with no frost texture, refraction, light or depth; the ice is a white line starburst (phone mid/finish). B4: the 2x3 ice-card grid is its own layout, but it sits on the shared nebula backdrop. C4: tapping the word card is direct and the ice wave rises per tap (phone mid, card '2/3 ICE FILLS'), but there is no crack, shatter, squash or particles, and the toast covers the card being tapped. D1: no in-world characters. E2: the same starburst on every card plus the shared reveal card; no shatter or thaw. F4: the word on each card is about 10px and 'n/3 ICE FILLS' about 6px; the label is truncated to '0 / 6 FRO' by the progress bar (phone start); the instruction paragraph is cut off under the live-guide panel. G4: the cards use the width well as large targets, but the label is truncated, the paragraph is clipped and the header is clipped. H5: freezing a racing thought is a sound metaphor for panic, but there is no slowing or calming visual.
perf_flags: p95 400ms phone / 850ms desktop, max 850ms (above the 34/120ms absolute limits; headless). Relatively about the fleet median (433/783).
long task max 1054ms on phone (91 long tasks)
games.strengths: The only game in this batch where you act on the word itself. The cards are big and thumb-friendly, and per-card ice progress gives readable step feedback. It has a dedicated engine (FreezeLiteralEngine), so it is a good base.
games.problems: Phone start: the '0 / 6 FRO' label is truncated and the instruction paragraph is hidden under the live guide; a character decal overlaps the 'me and' card. Phone mid: a dark toast ('CLEAR +1', ~6px) covers half of the 'my boss' card. Phone finish: a tilted toast with unreadable text sits over the cards. 'n/3 ICE FILLS' is about 6px everywhere. No characters. The shatter is promised but never drawn. The reveal is the generic card (desktop and phone reveal tiles). phone header title clipped to 'MOTIONAL RELEASE CONSO' and overlapped by the LVL pill (all 390 tiles).
improvements: Put an emotion character inside each card as the 'frozen' thought: tap 1 frost on its face, tap 2 it shivers and squashes, tap 3 it is encased in ice with a calm face. Thaw it to a smiling character in the finale.
Build a real FREEZE finale: all six ice blocks crack in a chain, shatter into refractive shards with a cold blue-to-warm light shift, and the freed characters float up calm.
Replace the flat gradient cards with frosted glass blocks: noise frost texture, inner refraction highlight, rim light and a cold fog layer with depth.
Add tap juice: a 0.08s squash on the card, a frost crackle burst at the touch point, and ice-crack lines that build up over the 3 taps.
Raise the card word to 15px or more and 'n/3' to 12px or more; stop the label truncating; move the paragraph above the live guide or shorten it.
Keep toasts off the card being tapped (dock them above the grid) and make their text 12px or more.
games.looks_like: 16, 41 (catalog A cluster); the gradient-card grid look recurs in other literal engines
